subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should WhatsApp adopt a Desktop linked-device identity as the supported default even if existing non-Desktop pairings must be detected and re-paired?
rationale: The likely code change is small, but changing the identity registered with WhatsApp can invalidate existing credentials and requires an intentional upgrade and recovery experience.

options.title: Desktop default with migration
options.body: Validate and adopt the Desktop identity, detect incompatible existing sessions, and guide affected users through a deliberate re-pair flow.

options.title: Preserve identity, repair sync
options.body: Keep the current identity and pursue a Baileys synchronization or initialization change only if live comparison proves it restores group delivery without re-pairing.

options.title: Expose an identity setting
options.body: Add a configuration choice only if neither identity is safe as a universal default, accepting a larger permanent support surface.

recommendation.title: Desktop default with migration
recommendation.body: Validate and adopt the Desktop identity, detect incompatible existing sessions, and guide affected users through a deliberate re-pair flow.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review and merge history covers the same WhatsApp socket creation and reconnect lifecycle boundary.
